git.title: Git
git.scopeTitle: The collection is one folder of a larger repository. Only changes in this folder are listed, and Stage all and Commit all changes leave other files alone.
git.restrictedNotice: This folder is not trusted yet, so Git is read-only: you can look at changes but not initialize, stage, commit or sync.
git.mergeNotice: A merge is in progress. Resolve each conflicted file, then commit to finish it.
git.noFolderHint: Open or save the collection to a folder first, or clone a repository, from the storage menu in the header.
git.noRepository: This folder is not a Git repository
git.noRepositoryHint: Initialize one to track changes, commit and sync your collection.
git.clean: No changes. Your collection matches the last commit.
git.mergeReady: Every conflict is resolved. Commit to finish the merge.
git.pickFile: Select a file to see what changed.
git.branchPlaceholder: New branch name, created from the current commit
git.noBranches: This repository has no branches yet. Commit something first.
git.noStashes: Nothing is stashed. A stash sets your uncommitted changes aside so you can switch branches cleanly.
git.filePathPlaceholder: File path for a single file's history, empty for the whole repository
git.noRemotes: No remotes. Add the address of a repository to fetch, pull and push.
git.readOnly: Trust this folder to change anything.
git.markersLeft: The result still has conflict markers. Edit them out or pick a side.
git.binaryDiff: This file is binary, so there is no line diff.

gitSession.discardMessage: {{path}} goes back to its last committed state. This cannot be undone.
gitSession.deleteBranchMessage: The branch {{name}} is deleted. Git refuses if it has commits that are not merged.
gitSession.restoreMessage: {{path}} is replaced by its content at {{commit}}. The current content stays in Git only if it was committed.
gitSession.abortMergeMessage: Everything from the merge is undone, including conflict resolutions you already made.
